title: Synthetic Medical Imaging with Pathology-Aware Variational Autoencoders

contributions.purpose: 提出病理感知 VAE 以在标签稀缺下保留临床显著特征
contributions.mechanism: VAE 的 ELBO 加特征保留损失(冻结提取器 ℓ2 特征匹配)+ 类条件潜先验 + 可选掩膜 IoU 项 + 类一致性项
contributions.evaluation: 合成基准下游分类 AUC 0.760→0.842、Sens@95%Spec 0.430→0.546、ECE 0.062→0.046、FID 32.3、SSIM 0.75(数据全合成,见 notes)
contributions.domain: 医学影像合成 / 标签稀缺
contributions.source_quote: We introduce a Pathology-Aware VAE (PA-VAE) with a feature-preservation loss and class-conditional latent prior

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的轻依赖评估流水线并做消融/鲁棒性
contributions.mechanism: 单命令重建全部图表+JSON 指标;程序化合成 chest X-ray(64x64,healthy/left/right opacity)
contributions.evaluation: 消融显示特征保留损失贡献最大(去除 ΔAUC -0.028);对抗式/时序漂移下中度退化
contributions.source_quote: ablations indicate the feature-preservation loss and class-conditional prior as principal contributors. Robustness analyses show moderate degradation under adversarial-like and temporal drift perturbations.
